skill.name: ai-partner-chat
skill.description: Provides context-aware AI partner chat using user personas, notes, conversation logs, and local vector search.
skill.summary: Helps an AI assistant personalize conversations with local notes, profiles, and memory-style retrieval.
skill.author: Cz07cring

security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally stores notes, profiles, conversation logs, and vector indexes under local Claude skill directories. Most static hits are false positives from markdown code fences, documentation snippets, or local paths, but the package still needs review because it installs scripts, writes local databases, reads cache paths, and documents scoped recursive deletion commands.

remediation.issue: Installer and documentation use recursive deletion for skill data directories.
remediation.suggestion: Replace rm -rf examples with a safer cleanup script that validates the resolved path before deletion and asks for confirmation.

remediation.issue: Conversation logs, personas, notes, and embeddings are persisted in local files and SQLite or Chroma storage.
remediation.suggestion: Clearly disclose stored data types, default paths, retention behavior, and deletion steps before users enable the skill.

remediation.issue: The skill depends on local Python scripts and third-party model libraries.
remediation.suggestion: Pin and review dependencies, avoid auto-running installation commands, and require explicit user approval for setup.

remediation.issue: Documentation contains many executable setup snippets.
remediation.suggestion: Separate runnable commands from explanatory examples and mark commands that modify user directories.

content.user_title: Personalize AI Conversations With Local Memory
content.value_statement: Generic assistants lose context across conversations and notes. This skill uses local personas, notes, logs, and vector search to make Claude, Codex, or Claude Code respond with more personal context.
actual_capabilities: Loads user and AI persona templates to shape conversation style.
Indexes notes into a local vector database for semantic retrieval.
Logs conversations and stores summaries for later context.
Analyzes learning signals such as tags, emotions, and thinking patterns.
Provides setup guidance for Python dependencies and local model cache use.
Supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
limitations: Requires local Python dependencies and model files before full use.
Stores personal notes and conversations on the local filesystem.
Quality depends on the accuracy of user-provided persona and note files.
Does not replace secure password managers, medical advice, or legal advice.

use_cases.title: Maintain a personal learning partner
use_cases.description: Use prior notes and reflections to receive responses that match your current learning stage and recurring questions.

use_cases.title: Build continuity across AI sessions
use_cases.description: Record conversation summaries and retrieve related history when discussing long-running projects or goals.

use_cases.title: Search personal notes by meaning
use_cases.description: Find related ideas in local markdown notes without relying only on exact keyword matches.

prompt_templates.title: Start with my profile
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my persona and notes to answer this question in a style that fits my learning preferences: [question].

prompt_templates.title: Find related notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Search my local notes for ideas related to [topic], then summarize the most relevant themes before answering.

prompt_templates.title: Reflect on a conversation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this exchange and identify what should be remembered for future conversations: [conversation summary].

prompt_templates.title: Synthesize long-term patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my notes, prior conversations, tags, and emotion timeline to identify recurring blockers and suggest a focused next step.

output_examples.input: What should I study next based on my React notes?
output_examples.output: A short summary of related React notes, a recommendation for the next concept, and a practice task matched to your learning style.

output_examples.input: Remember what we decided about my project direction.
output_examples.output: A concise memory-style summary of the decision, the reason behind it, and suggested tags for later retrieval.

output_examples.input: Why do I keep getting stuck on this topic?
output_examples.output: A pattern-based reflection that connects recent notes, confusion points, and a practical next action.

best_practices: Review where notes, profiles, logs, and vector databases are stored before using the skill.
Keep persona files specific, current, and free of secrets or credentials.
Use clear note titles and tags so retrieval results are easier to inspect.
anti_patterns: Do not store passwords, API keys, private keys, or regulated records in notes or persona files.
Do not run cleanup commands unless you understand which local directory they delete.
Do not expect perfect memory; verify important facts against source notes.

faq.question: Does this skill send my notes to an external service?
faq.answer: The report evidence shows local files, local scripts, and local vector storage. Review dependencies and runtime behavior before adding sensitive notes.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists Claude Code as a supported tool, along with Claude and Codex.

faq.question: What data does it store?
faq.answer: It can store personas, notes, conversation logs, summaries, tags, emotion analysis, and vector indexes in local files.

faq.question: Is setup required?
faq.answer: Yes. The documentation includes Python dependencies and local model cache steps for vector search features.

faq.question: Can I delete stored memory?
faq.answer: The documentation includes data cleanup commands, but review the target path carefully before deleting anything.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: It is best for users who want a local, context-aware AI partner for learning, reflection, and project continuity.
